Survey.Name: Campus Coffee Habits
Survey.Description: Made-up questionnaire for the PRISM class: coffee habits (items 1-8) and attitudes (items 9-12)

Scores.Name: Habit
Scores.Description: How often the coffee habits apply (cch01-cch08)

ScoringGuidelines.en: Habit = sum of items 1-8, Attitude = sum of items 9-12, Total = sum of items 1-12. Higher scores mean more coffee habits. Items 13 (cups per day) and 14 (decaf) are not part of a score.
